subject: [PATCH 1/5] x86/paravirt: Use static_call() for the paravirt spinlock ops

reviews.author: Borislav Petkov
reviews.summary: Reviewer Petkov suggested redefining X86_FEATURE_PVUNLOCK to a static value, allowing for easier reuse of the feature flag.

2026-08-04.patch_summary: This patch replaces the use of paravirt-ops ALTERNATIVE machinery for dispatching spinlock operations on x86 architecture with static_call(). This change allows the target function to be updated at runtime, which is necessary for implementing a contended_release tracepoint. The patch updates several files in the kernel and includes changes to support module safety and boot testing on native and KVM PV guest systems.
